entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, I finally made up with Eiko.

entries.speaker: Makoto

That's incredible.[clr 27]
Your slap worked wonders.
I'm so relieved.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah. I'm relieved she didn't[n]get caught in his web...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're still not gonna let me[n]forget that, hm? Well, I'm glad[n]she didn't get into any danger...

Back to studying?
For your sister?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No, that's not it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. I thought there was[n]no point in continuing[n]my studies, but...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's for nobody but myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This time I'm not seeking anyone's[n]praise, and I'm not trying to[n]show off my intelligence.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I simply want to fulfill my[n]own personal goals and dreams.

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But thanks to you, I've[n]finally come to realize it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My dream... is to become a[n]police commissioner. That[n]is why I need to study.
Police commissioner?
That sounds difficult.[clr 27]
Why did you choose that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, the head of police operations.[n]It will require me to have an[n]extensive academic background.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're right. I will need an[n]extensive academic background.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Because it's the head of police[n]operations. I'll need an extensive[n]academic background though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There are too many incidents in[n]this country that are never brought[n]to light. That host was one.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Villains who prey on the hearts of[n]the weak with cowardly, legally[n]questionable methods...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My father risked his life trying to[n]catch a group of those people. I[n]will never forgive them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I won't be able to eradicate[n]them all on my own...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Instead, I want to head an[n]organization that will destroy the[n]lawless and help rescue victims.
What an admirable goal.[clr 27]
That's an amazing dream.
Your father would be proud.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm glad you think so.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That is the justice I aim for.[n]I also believe it will be a[n]continuation of my father's legacy.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is... but I won't let[n]it end as merely a dream.

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly, it's a little strange[n]that I found the true meaning of[n]my studies outside of my studies.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Thank you for all your help.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Must have been difficult[n]babysitting the uptight[n]Miss President, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Just kidding.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even so, I'm glad I asked you...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think now I'll be able to see[n]the world even more differently.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Actually, I'm sure I can.[n]Because... I have you.
I feel a strong bond with Makoto...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can sense it... The power[n]within me has grown... No,[n]it's been born anew!
Makoto's Persona [clr 1]Johanna[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Anat[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way, you can rely on[n]me for anything you need. I[n]want us to be equals...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now then, in order to fulfill my[n]dream, I'll need to be accepted[n]into my first choice college.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *giggle* What a funny thought...[n]Studying to become a head of[n]police while working as a thief...
Haha, yeah.
It's not funny at all.
Just be careful, okay?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But perhaps it's not as[n]contradictory as it seems.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The objective is the same...[n]Exposing the evil lurking[n]in the dark shadows...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm. You may be right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: S-So... you see...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: U-Um...
What's wrong?
Do you want to study?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was thinking... maybe we could[n]study some things we don't have[n]experience in yet...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Would that be okay...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I want to be with you.

Makoto and I spent some[n]time alone together...
